subject: Show intermediate results while function is executing

messages.author: 4d1320f0b0761595
messages.subject: Show intermediate results while function is executing
parts: What's the best way to show intermediate results while function is running? E.g. I'm running lots of time-consuming simulations and would like to somehow show the results of those simulations as they appear. Or I would like to be able to print warnings that will help me to decide if I should stop the function and restart it with new parameters instead of waiting for it to finish. In usual R environment I would use cat() inside functions. Is there an alternative in Shiny?

messages.author: 3b718630a63ab359
messages.subject: Re: Show intermediate results while function is executing
parts:
If you want to print on the shiny UI, in my previous post (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/8R-LJjhjvw0), Joe gave a pretty good solution and it works.

If you run the shiny server locally and printing things on the terminal is fine, then you can just use print().
